# Quiz night question bank

The quizmaster reads each question aloud. The answer follows the dash.

1. Which river flows through Cairo? - The Nile
2. Who composed The Four Seasons? - Vivaldi
3. In what year did the Berlin Wall come down? - 1989
4. Which instrument has 47 strings and seven pedals? - The concert harp
5. What is the capital of Australia? - Canberra
6. Which queen was known as the Virgin Queen? - Elizabeth I
7. Which band released the album Rumours in 1977? - Fleetwood Mac
8. Which strait separates Spain from Morocco? - The Strait of Gibraltar
9. Who was the first emperor of Rome? - Augustus
10. Which composer wrote the Moonlight Sonata? - Beethoven
11. Which desert covers most of northern Africa? - The Sahara
12. Which ship carried the Pilgrims to America in 1620? - The Mayflower
13. Tiebreaker, closest guess wins: how many bones are in the adult human body? - 206
